## 席位核对 — REWORK (L1-b)

Head-sha: 06b8d69dd9404056bc1e2a15c6118e8c223edb23 · read 2026-11-21T05:55Z

### 维护者速读

- 文章页本身按效果图 25 做到了：不再显示应用菜单，左边只有一栏文档导航，顶部有「← 返回〈应用名〉」；顶栏写「〈应用名〉 / 文档」；标题上方的路径带手册名；本页目录会随滚动高亮；页尾有上一篇和下一篇；正文 720px、15px；流程图可以放大。
- 要返工一处：应用菜单在**所有**文档页上都去掉了，但「返回应用」的入口只加在文章页上。应用的文档首页（文章路径里「文档」这个链接点进去就是它），以及空手册或找不到的手册页，现在既没有应用菜单、也没有返回入口，只能用顶栏的应用切换器或浏览器后退才能回去。
- 改完后可以合。所有改动只影响显示，可以直接撤回。

### Must-fix

- **M1 — the app's docs index and the empty / unknown book page lose every way back to the app.** `isAppDocsPath` matches `/apps/APP/docs` and everything under it, so `ConsoleLayout` drops `UnifiedSidebar` on all of those routes. Inside an app, `DocShell` now returns its children bare, so its bar is gone too. Only `DocPage` gains `DocsNav` with 「← Back to APP」:
  - `/apps/APP/docs` renders `AppDocsIndex` (AppContent's index route). It has a link to `/docs` and no link to the app. This PR's own path above every article links here (`<Link to={base}>` "Documentation"), so a reader one click away from the article lands on a page with no app menu and no back link.
  - `BookPage`'s "This book has no documents yet" / "Book not found" branch is the same.

  The way back that remains is the app switcher in the bar (open it, pick the same app) or the browser's Back. That is the "回不来" the maintainer named on #35424. Fix: give those pages the same 「← Back to APP」 link, for example the `backTo` block from `DocsNav` or a small shared piece. Alternatively, keep the app menu off only on the article route. Pin it in `docs-portal.test.tsx` for the index and the not-found book. If you choose to leave this to PR-b, say so in the body and on #35424. Either way the gap should not ship silently.

### Should-fix

- S1 — the body has no 维护者速读 section. The fleet's PRs carry one for Sales, in Chinese and at business level (standing rule 11-19 22:04Z). Add four lines: what the reader sees, why, the worst case, and what is needed from Sales.
- S2 (wording, zh-Hans/zh-Hant): `help.diagram` = 「流程图」, but the dialog title is used for every Mermaid diagram (sequence, ER, state and others), not only flowcharts. 「图示」 or 「图表」 matches the en "Diagram". `help.searchDocs` 「搜索文档」 labels a field that filters titles and summaries in the column. The body says the full-text search is item 9. The label is acceptable, but the item-9 search will need a different label so the two don't read the same.

### Nits

- N1: the enlarged dialog re-inserts the same SVG string, so the inline copy and the dialog copy share `id="os-mermaid-N"` and its marker ids while the dialog is open. Browsers resolve both copies to the same definitions, so it renders fine. It is still a duplicate id; renaming the dialog copy's root id would avoid it.
- N2: the pager's `←` / `→` glyphs and the `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` icons do not flip in `ar`. Check whether the console mirrors elsewhere; if it doesn't, leave it.

### Checked

- l1-face at `06b8d69d`: every item ok. `Part of #35424` is right: items 6–9 go to the next PR. All four touched packages are in the changeset (console, app-shell, plugin-markdown, i18n). The declaration is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. all-checks was not measured at read time: 45 success, 2 pending (Check Changeset, PR-body guards), 0 failed.
- `ConsoleLayout.isAppDocsPath`: `^/apps/[^/]+/docs(?:/|$)`, so it does not catch `/apps/x/docsfoo`. It is pinned in a table test.
- `AppHeader`: a `docs` crumb from `help.documentation`. The toggle slot is held empty when `routeType === 'docs'`, so the mark does not jump.
- `DocPage`:
  - `packageBooks` is every book whose `pkgOfBook` equals the current book's package, so no other package's book is listed (pinned).
  - The back link uses `matchAppBySegment` + `useServedAppLabel`, the same label the bar shows.
  - `articleNeighbours` walks `bookArticles`, which drops separators and link-only entries and counts a doc placed twice once (pinned).
  - At `lg` and below, the column folds into a `<details>`.
- `useActiveHeading`:
  - It listens in the capture phase on `document`, passive, rAF-throttled with one frame in flight, and resize is covered too.
  - The listener is cleaned up, and the effect re-keys on the joined ids, not on array identity.
  - The "at end" arm only trusts a scroll container that contains the first heading.
- Mermaid enlarge: with no provider, `EnlargeableDiagram` returns the inline element unchanged, with no wrapper (pinned). With a provider, the dialog has an sr-only `DialogTitle`.
- Exports: `@object-ui/plugin-markdown` adds `MermaidEnlargeContext` / `MermaidEnlargeText`, an additive widening. The seat runs the TIER_DEFAULT declaration L2. `@object-ui/app-shell` (private) adds `matchAppBySegment` and `useServedAppLabel`.
- Locales: 12 keys in all 11 packs with real text (read in zh-Hans, ja and ar). zh-Hant is regenerated, and its earlier red run is disclosed in the body. 「全部文档」 reuses `help.allDocs`.

### Owed

- A new head for M1. I'll read only the delta.
- L2 (declaration, TIER_DEFAULT) is the seat's; this L1 does not replace it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `06b8d69dd9404056bc1e2a15c6118e8c223edb23`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #35424 (body, the triage comment, the claim and its Clause-② amendment), the PR body, its 30-file list, and the net diff against `main` on this head. Gates are taken from the head's check-runs: every PR-side run concluded `success` or was skipped by design. Both `Check Changeset` runs (jobs 136745966805 and 136751223960) succeeded. `UI Published Artifacts` is push-only by its `if:`, so its skip here is expected.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/plugin-markdown`: public surface widened, right.**
  - The entry adds `export { MermaidEnlargeContext, type MermaidEnlargeText }`. That is a React context, `null` by default, and a two-field text interface (`enlarge`, `title`).
  - Nothing is removed or renamed. `Mermaid` keeps its signature `({ chart }: { chart: string })`.
  - With no provider, `EnlargeableDiagram` returns the diagram element itself. There is no wrapper and no control, so every existing markdown surface renders the same DOM as before. `Mermaid.enlarge-35424.test.tsx` pins both arms.
  - The new runtime import (`Dialog`, `DialogContent`, `DialogTitle`) comes from `@object-ui/components`. The package already depends on it (`workspace:*`, already imported by `index.tsx`), so no dependency is added.
  - The enlarged view uses the same strict-mode SVG string the inline diagram already trusts. No new HTML enters the page.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: public surface widened, right, but not named on the declaration line (N1).**
  - 12 `help.*` keys are added to each of the 11 packs: 132 added lines, 0 removed.
  - `{{app}}` is kept in `backToApp` in every pack (checked line by line).
  - The packs ship through the published `./locales` export, and `en` is re-exported from the entry. This is an additive widening, the same reading the records on #33485 and #35272 gave added keys.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`: no published surface.** `private: true` is confirmed in its `package.json`. The new index exports `matchAppBySegment` and `useServedAppLabel`, and the module export `isAppDocsPath`, publish nothing. The claim amendment says so, and it is right.
- **`@object-ui/console`: published surface unchanged, right.** The package's `exports` is `./plugin.js` and `plugin.d.ts`, which this diff does not touch. `DocsNav`, `docs-reading`, `useActiveHeading` and `ArticlePager` are app-internal modules.
- **Accept set of the routes: unchanged, right.** No route, API, doc metadata or spec key changes.
  - `isAppDocsPath` (`^/apps/[^/]+/docs(?:/|$)`) only decides whether the app menu is mounted. It is read on the router-relative `location.pathname`, the same way as the existing `isRecordPagePath`.
  - Its table pins the two near misses: `/apps/crm/docsearch` and `/apps/crm/crm_lead/docs`.
- **Behaviour at the shell boundary: right, and within the card's scope.**
  - On every `/apps/APP/docs` route, `DocShell` now draws no bar of its own. That covers the app docs index and the empty or refused states, not only the article.
  - Those pages keep the app bar, which now reads 「APP / Documentation」, so the way back stays one step.
  - The article page adds the `DocsNav` column. The card's acceptance names the article page, and the all-docs index is PR-b's items 6–9.
- **Previous / next pager: N3.**
  - `articleNeighbours` answers `null` on both sides when the routed doc is not in the slug's book.
  - `DocPage` does not redirect such a URL: only a book-name segment is redirected (`bookNamedBy`).
  - So a hand-typed `/docs/BOOK_A/DOC_OF_BOOK_B` draws both "first article" and "last article" cards.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset `.changeset/35424-docs-reader-one-column.md`: right.** It bumps `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-markdown` and `@object-ui/i18n`, each as `patch`.
  - Each of the four has moved source.
  - The three published packages are all owed an entry, and none is missed. `@object-ui/components` is only consumed.
  - The private `app-shell` entry is harmless, and `Check Changeset` accepted it.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`: right.** A UI string pack, a React context and console layout are not the metadata protocol an author writes against. Under AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist 3; maintainer ruling A on #25105) the level follows that line alone, and `none` takes `patch`.
- **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: right.**
  - The diff widens two published surfaces (plugin-markdown's entry and i18n's packs) and narrows none. Nothing is removed, so no BREAKING banner or ADR-0087 disposition is owed.
  - The line reads byte-identically in the PR body and the changeset body, and the claim's amendment carries the same value.
  - Its description names only the plugin-markdown exports (N1).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag: `app-shell`'s full suite was not run locally ("outran a 50-minute local budget; CI runs them").** Answered. `Test UI` and all 16 of its shards succeeded on this head.
- **Dev flag: card item 5's "no blank screen at the end of the page" was not reproduced.**
  - The PR reports 32 px below the pager at the end of the scroll, against 24 px on `main`.
  - The card's observation was made on the hosted preview, whose console the card itself says predates `main`.
  - Answered as measured, not fixed: nothing in this diff could cause it. It is owed one re-check on the hosted environment once this deploys. If it recurs there, it belongs to the card, not to this PR.
- **Dev flag: the zh-Hant packs were hand-written and then regenerated.** Answered. `69823f040` regenerates them with `gen:zh-hant`, and the generated-pack test is in the green `Test UI` run.
- **`open_questions`: none raised.** The claim's scope note (the column's search filters titles and summaries, because the list endpoint carries no full text) is a stated scope, and it holds in `filterBookArticles`. Full-text search is PR-b item 9.
- **SQL push-down: no finding.**
  - The diff adds no request. The package filter (`pkgOfBook(b) === pkg`), the title filter and the reading order all run over the `books` and `docs` lists that `useBookData` already loads for the reader's book resolution.
  - `useMetadata().apps` is the shell's cached app list.
  - There is no new id materialisation and no in-app join over data a query could have narrowed.

**Findings**

- **N1 · nit.** The `Clause-②:` line's description, in the PR body and the changeset, names only `@object-ui/plugin-markdown`. The 12 additive `help.*` keys in the published `@object-ui/i18n` packs are a public-surface widening as well. The value `yes (widening)` is right, so nothing is re-declared. Naming i18n in the description would make the line's enumeration complete.
- **N2 · nit.** The changeset body, which ships as the CHANGELOG, names the column's foot link 「All docs →」. The shipped `en` value of `help.allDocs` is 'All documentation', as the PR body says. The CHANGELOG text should match.
- **N3 · nit.** When the routed doc is not in the slug's book, the pager draws "This is the first article in this book" and "This is the last article in this book" together. Both statements are false. Drawing no pager, for example when `bookArticles(resolvedBook)` does not hold `name`, would be accurate. This is a rare, hand-typed URL. It has no contract effect.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对 — delta ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: 0bbda2d50d881b91df60ed5b76c257088c814ceb · read 2026-11-21T06:32Z · delta from `06b8d69d` (REWORK 7058267060)

### 维护者速读

- 可以合：应用内的每个文档页现在都有「← 返回〈应用名〉」，包括文档首页、空手册页和找不到的页面；阅读页上只出现一次（在左栏里）。上一轮要返工的那处已经修好。
- 另外：中文「流程图」改成了「图示」，PR 正文补上了维护者速读。

### Delta

- M1 done:
  - Inside an app, `DocShell` now draws a `docs-back-bar` with the shared `AppDocsBackLink`. The target comes from `useAppDocsBackTo`: `matchAppBySegment` + `useServedAppLabel`, the same answer the column had, moved out of `DocPage`.
  - Every `DocShell` user gets the bar: `AppDocsIndex`, `BookPage` (empty and not found), `DocsSlug` not found, `DocRefusal`, and `DocPage`'s missing, conflict and error branches. Only the reader passes `backLink={false}`, because its column carries the link.
  - `DocsNav` renders the same component, so there is one link markup and one `data-testid`.
  - New pins:
    - the docs index (multi-book, no redirect, `where` stays on `/docs`) leads back to `/apps/com.example.showcase`;
    - `/apps/crm/docs/nonesuch` leads back to `/apps/crm`;
    - the reader has no `docs-back-bar`.
- S1 done: the body has a four-line 维护者速读.
- S2: zh-Hans `help.diagram` is now 「图示」, and zh-Hant is regenerated as 「圖示」. The search label is kept, with a note to PR-b; that answers it.
- N1 done: the dialog copy renames the render-id prefix (`os-mermaid-N` → `os-mermaid-N-enlarged`) everywhere in its SVG string: the root id, the style selectors, the markers and their references. No duplicate ids remain while the dialog is open. The pin is reported red with the rename removed. The match takes this SVG's own root id, so the split cannot reach another diagram's id.
- N2: left as is, since nothing else in the console mirrors. Agreed.
- The seat's L2 text points are in the changeset: the Clause-② line names the i18n keys, and the foot link reads 「All documentation →」, matching `help.allDocs`.
- l1-face at `0bbda2d5`: clean (47 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending, mergeable clean).

### Must-fix / Should-fix

None.

### Nit (optional)

- N3: the reader passes `backLink={false}` unconditionally, but its column (`docsNav`) is drawn only when `packageBooks` is non-empty. A reader page whose book cannot be placed in a package would draw neither the column nor the bar. `backLink={!docsNav}` covers that case with no change elsewhere. No route reaches it today that I could find, so this is optional.

### Owed

- L1 is final on this green head.
- L2 (declaration, TIER_DEFAULT) is the seat's. This L1 does not replace it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `0bbda2d50d881b91df60ed5b76c257088c814ceb`
Local-runs: none

This record replaces the earlier one on `06b8d69dd9404056bc1e2a15c6118e8c223edb23`.

**Inputs:**
- card #35424, its body and every comment: the claim, the Clause-② amendment, the earlier brief and record, L1-b's REWORK on `06b8d69` and its delta ACCEPT
- the PR body at this head and its 32-file list
- the one-commit delta `0bbda2d50` ("every docs page inside an app leads back to the app") and the net diff against `main`

**Gates**, from this head's check-runs:
- 47 succeeded and 15 were skipped; none failed or is in progress.
- Both `Check Changeset` runs succeeded (jobs 136755203229 and 136755412405), and all 16 `Test UI` shards succeeded.
- The skipped runs are the same set as on the earlier head: core-only, opt-in, merge-queue-only and push-only lanes. `UI Published Artifacts` is push-only by its `if:`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/plugin-markdown`: the public surface is unchanged by the delta, and the net widening is right.**
  - The net entry still adds exactly `MermaidEnlargeContext` and `type MermaidEnlargeText`. `Mermaid` keeps `({ chart }: { chart: string })`.
  - The delta adds one module-private function, `enlargedSvg`, and exports nothing new.
  - `enlargedSvg` renames the render-id prefix (`os-mermaid-N`, the id `Mermaid.tsx` passes to `mermaid.render`) to `os-mermaid-N-enlarged` in the dialog's copy only. That covers the root id, the scoped style selectors and the marker ids together, so the open dialog no longer duplicates ids.
  - The transform only appends text to an existing token of the same strict-mode SVG. It cannot introduce markup.
  - With no provider the component still returns the inline element unchanged. The new `useMemo` runs before that early return, so the hook order is stable.
  - The test now pins the root id, the marker id, the `marker-end` reference and that no `os-mermaid-` id appears twice.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: right.**
  - The net change is still 12 additive `help.*` keys in each of the 11 packs, with nothing removed.
  - The delta changes one value in two packs: `help.diagram` becomes 「图示」 in zh-Hans and 「圖示」 in zh-Hant, replacing 「流程图」 / 「流程圖」.
  - No key is added, removed or renamed. The new word fits every Mermaid diagram type, not only flowcharts.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`: no published surface.** It is `private: true`, and the delta does not touch it.
- **`@object-ui/console`: the published surface is unchanged, right.** `exports` is `./plugin.js` and `plugin.d.ts`, which the diff does not touch.
  - The new `AppDocsBackLink.tsx` and `useAppDocsBackTo.ts` are app-internal.
  - `useAppDocsBackTo` is the earlier inline back-link logic from `DocPage`, moved out unchanged: `matchAppBySegment` plus `useServedAppLabel`, `undefined` off an app.
- **Behaviour at the shell boundary: right, and L1-b's M1 is closed.**
  - Inside an app, `DocShell` now draws `docs-back-bar` with the shared `AppDocsBackLink` on every docs page: the app's docs index, an empty book, and an unknown book or doc. On the portal, `backTo` is `undefined` and the old header is kept.
  - The reader passes `backLink={false}`, so its column carries the link once. `DocPage`'s loading, not-found and refused states keep the default and do get the bar.
  - `docs-portal.test.tsx` pins the docs index, a not-found entry, and the reader drawing no second bar.
  - The accept set of the routes is unchanged. `isAppDocsPath` is untouched since the earlier head.
- **Previous / next pager: N3 carried forward.** The delta does not touch `articleNeighbours` or the pager. A doc addressed under a book slug that does not hold it still draws "first article" and "last article" together.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset `.changeset/35424-docs-reader-one-column.md`: right.**
  - It bumps `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-markdown` and `@object-ui/i18n`, each as `patch`.
  - The delta adds no package: all four still move, and the three published ones are each owed their entry.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`: right.** Under AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist 3; maintainer ruling A on #25105), `none` takes `patch`.
- **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: right, and N1 is closed.**
  - The line now reads `@object-ui/plugin-markdown exports MermaidEnlargeContext and MermaidEnlargeText; @object-ui/i18n adds 12 help.* keys; nothing removed`. That names both published widenings.
  - It reads byte-identically in the PR body and the changeset body.
  - Nothing narrows, so no BREAKING banner or ADR-0087 disposition is owed.
